mostWorthwhile.text: Following the kidney signal to developing red cells was worthwhile: the low-oxygen cue explained why the body adjusts their production.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding developing red cells to the body mostly confirmed the renewal route already shown, so it felt a little repetitive.

surprise.text: I was surprised that inspecting the bone-removing cells automatically started removing old bone; it also clarified the order.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, although I needed the compatibility hint to know how to begin bone remodeling.

continue.text: I would continue if another chapter explored a new connection in the body. The kidney-to-marrow signal made me curious, though some assembly steps felt predictable.
